parts: P105 sun, P107 planets, F202 gear 2, F203 pinion, F204 intermediate shaft, A302/A303 generator gear-shaft, A308 OSG gear, A312 PCU gear
condition_en: Carburized, hardened, sub-zero treated, double tempered at about 200-230 degC (above the 145-171 degC bulk temperatures of step 2.4)
condition_tr: Sementasyon, sertleştirme, sıfır altı işlem, yaklaşık 200-230 °C'de çift menevişleme (2.4'teki 145-171 °C gövde sıcaklıklarının üstünde)
hardness_case: Surface 58-63 HRC; effective case depth to 550 HV after grinding 0.5-0.7 mm on the main gears (0.4-0.6 mm on the m 1.5 accessory gears; at most 0.4 m_n); core at least 30 HRC (STR-06); retained austenite at most 15% (TBR)
finish: Flanks ground, then superfinished to Ra <= 0.15 um, Rz <= 0.8 um (STR-09); planet bore (outer race) ground and superfinished, Ra <= 0.1 um (TBR); roots protuberance-hobbed, not ground
ndt: Temper etch after grinding (ISO 14104 / AMS 2649), magnetic particle (ASTM E1444), case depth and core hardness on a test coupon of each heat-treat lot
protection_en: Oil-wetted, no coating; preservation oil for storage
protection_tr: Yağla ıslanıyor, kaplama yok; depolamada koruma yağı

condition_en: Quenched and tempered, stress relieved, gear shaped, gas nitrided (AMS 2759/6)
condition_tr: Su verilip menevişlenmiş, gerilim giderilmiş, dişleri planyalanmış, gaz nitrürlenmiş (AMS 2759/6)
hardness_case: Surface at least 650 HV (STR-06), aluminium-free steel; nitriding depth (core + 50 HV) 0.5-0.7 mm (the planet-ring contact needs 0.40 mm at LD-02); compound (white) layer removed or at most 10 um (TBR)
finish: Flanks honed, then superfinished to Ra <= 0.15 um, Rz <= 0.8 um (STR-09; the step 2.4 rating used Rz 1.0, so it is conservative)
ndt: Magnetic particle (ASTM E1444); nitride depth and hardness on a coupon nitrided with the part
protection_en: Oil-wetted; the outer seat in the case: no coating
protection_tr: Yağla ıslanıyor; gövdedeki dış yuva: kaplama yok

parts: P103 carrier with propeller shaft, F212 PT output shaft (forged hollow, integral flanges), P106 sun quill, P112/F209/F210 nuts, A307/A311/A315/A317 quills, A309/A313 pad adapters, L403 transfer sleeve, S621-S628 seat liners
condition_en: Quenched and tempered to 1240 MPa tensile (AMS 2759/1); splines of the sun quill and the transfer sleeve bore gas nitrided (AMS 2759/6, TBR)
condition_tr: Su verilip 1240 MPa çekme dayanımına menevişlenmiş (AMS 2759/1); güneş mili kamaları ve transfer manşonu deliği gaz nitrürlenmiş (AMS 2759/6, TBR)
hardness_case: 38-42 HRC core; nitrided splines at least 600 HV (TBR)
finish: Bearing journals ground Ra <= 0.4 um; fillets polished; carrier pin bores line-bored to the 0.010 mm true position of step 2.4
ndt: Ultrasonic of the forging (AMS 2630), magnetic particle (ASTM E1444) after final machining
protection_en: Oil-wetted surfaces bare; the propeller shaft outside the nose and the flange: zinc-nickel (AMS 2417) with hydrogen embrittlement bake, epoxy primer and topcoat (ENV-03)
protection_tr: Yağla ıslanan yüzeyler çıplak; burun dışındaki pervane mili ve flanş: çinko-nikel (AMS 2417), hidrojen gevrekliği fırınlaması, epoksi astar ve son kat (ENV-03)
status: set (steel propeller shaft 120/100, step 2.1); TBR (AISI 4340 grade, step 2.5)

parts: P104 planet pins (inner race of the planet bearing)
condition_en: Carburized, hardened, tempered; pressed into the carrier (LN2 shrink) and retained
condition_tr: Sementasyon, sertleştirme, menevişleme; taşıyıcıya presle (sıvı azotla daraltarak) takılıp sabitleniyor
hardness_case: Surface 60-64 HRC, case 1.0-1.5 mm (raceway needs 0.10 mm at LD-02), core 40-48 HRC (TBR)
finish: Raceway ground and superfinished Ra <= 0.1 um, roller crown matched (bearing supplier)
ndt: Temper etch, magnetic particle; bearing supplier's raceway inspection
status: proposed: a separate pin keeps the 4340 carrier of step 2.5 (the CATIA carrier has the pins in one body)

parts: P101 planetary case, F201 first-stage case, A301 accessory cover, A304 generator cartridge
specification: AMS-A-21180 (class giving at least 310 MPa tensile and 240 MPa yield in the designated areas, the step 2.8 allowables; class number TBR)
condition_en: Sand cast (bonded sand cores for the oil passages, chills at the bearing bosses), solution treated, quenched, artificially aged (T6, AMS 2771); optional hot isostatic pressing (TBR)
condition_tr: Kum döküm (yağ kanalları için bağlı kum maçaları, rulman göbeklerinde soğutucular), çözeltiye alma, su verme, yapay yaşlandırma (T6, AMS 2771); isteğe bağlı sıcak izostatik presleme (TBR)
hardness_case: Not applicable (about 85-95 HB); steel seat liners in the bearing bores
finish: Machined faces Ra 1.6 um; bearing liner bores Ra 0.8 um; flange face flatness 0.03 mm (TBR)
ndt: Radiography 100% (ASTM E1742, grading to ASTM E155 reference radiographs): AMS 2175 grade B in the critical zones (flange root, conical nose, bearing bosses, ring seat), grade C elsewhere (TBR, STR-10); fluorescent penetrant (ASTM E1417); separately cast test bars from each melt and coupons cut from a casting per lot; oil passages pressure tested at 1650 kPa (1.5 x the 1100 kPa relief, TBR)
protection_en: Outside: chromate-free conversion coating (MIL-DTL-5541 Type II) + epoxy primer (MIL-PRF-23377, non-chromate) + topcoat (MIL-PRF-85285); oil-wetted inside: conversion coating only; faying surfaces with steel and titanium parts installed wet with a corrosion-inhibiting sealant (ENV-03)
protection_tr: Dış: kromatsız dönüşüm kaplaması (MIL-DTL-5541 Tip II) + epoksi astar (MIL-PRF-23377, kromatsız) + son kat (MIL-PRF-85285); yağla ıslanan iç: yalnız dönüşüm kaplaması; çelik ve titanyum parçalarla temas yüzeyleri korozyon önleyici sızdırmazlık maddesiyle ıslak montaj (ENV-03)
status: set (A357-T6, Decision 6 of step 2.8); TBR (class, grades)

finish: Machined Ra 1.6 um; bearing seat of the housing Ra 0.8 um
ndt: Ultrasonic of the bar or forging (AMS 2631), fluorescent penetrant (ASTM E1417)
protection_en: Anodized against galling on fits and threads (AMS 2488, TBR); installed wet on the A357 nose
protection_tr: Geçme ve dişlerde sıvanmaya karşı anodize (AMS 2488, TBR); A357 burna ıslak montaj

parts: L402 external oil tubes, E503 mist lines, E504 bleed line

condition_tr: Bükülmüş, bağlantılara kaynaklı ya da sert lehimli; havşalı ya da kiriş contalı uçlar (TBR)
ndt: Proof pressure test 1.5 x the 1100 kPa relief; radiography of welds (TBR)
protection_en: Passivated; fire resistant by material (SAF-05); bleed line insulated (100 degC air)
protection_tr: Pasifleştirilmiş; malzemesiyle yangına dayanıklı (SAF-05); hava hattı yalıtımlı (100 °C hava)

condition_tr: Su verilmiş ve menevişlenmiş; ısıl işlemden sonra ovalanmış dişler

protection_tr: Çinko-nikel, hidrojen gevrekliği fırınlamasıyla; helisel tel insertlere takılır
